# Capabilities

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/build_agent_index.py from docs/field-guide/task_cards.yaml; edit the cards, not this page. -->

Each row is a capability name from Goodfire Silico's capabilities page (https://docs.goodfire.com/concepts/capabilities/), mapped to the TorchLens call for it. Rows without a call say where the work belongs instead.

| Capability | TorchLens | Call |
|---|---|---|
| Activation harvesting | [Capture a forward pass and read an activation](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/see_and_inspect.md); [Keep only the activations you need](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/see_and_inspect.md); [Get named layers' outputs as tensors](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/extract_features.md); [Extract features over a whole dataset](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/extract_features.md); [Record a few sites over many forwards cheaply](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/performance.md); [Stream a large capture to disk](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/intervention_api.md) | `trace = tl.trace(model, x)`; `trace = tl.trace(model, x, save=tl.func("relu"))`; `features = tl.extract(model, x, ["layer3", "avgpool"])`; `tl.extract_dataset(model, stimuli, ["layer3", "avgpool"], path="features")`; `recording = tl.record(model, x, save=tl.func("relu"))`; `trace = tl.trace(model, x, save=tl.in_module("encoder"), storage=tl.to_disk("run.tlspec"))` |
| Featurizer training | [Gather activations to train a sparse autoencoder](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/recipes/sae_trainers.md); TorchLens supplies the activations; the trainer is external. | `tl.extract_dataset(model, stimuli, ["layer4"], batch_size=64, path="sae_acts")` |
| Probing | [Collect features to train a linear probe](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/extract_features.md) | `tl.extract_dataset(model, stimuli, ["layer4"], path="probe_features")` |
| Activation monitoring | Not built in. |  |
| Automated interpretation | Not built in. |  |
| Steering | [Steer a language model during generation](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/guides/fast_paths.md); [Add a direction to one site and capture the result](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/intervene.md) | `tl.when(tl.module("model.layers.6"), tl.steer(direction, strength=4.0)).bind(lm)`; `steered = tl.trace(model, x, intervene=tl.when(tl.module("layer3"), tl.steer(direction, strength=4.0, dim=1)))` |
| Causal analysis | [Ablate a component and measure the effect](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/intervene.md); [Patch activations from one input into another](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/field-guide/intervene.md); [Sweep edits over one site](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/intervention_api.md); [Compare two runs site by site](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/intervention_api.md) | `ablated = tl.trace(model, x).fork().do(tl.module("layer3"), tl.zero_ablate(), model=model, inputs=x)`; `patched = tl.trace(model, x_corrupt).fork().do(tl.module("layer3"), tl.patch_from(tl.trace(model, x_clean)), model=model, inputs=x_corrupt)`; `runs = tl.sweep(model, x, tl.module("layer3"), [tl.scale(s) for s in (0.0, 0.5, 2.0)], include_baseline=True)`; `bundle = tl.Bundle({"clean": tl.trace(model, x), "ablated": ablated}, baseline="clean")` |
| Parameter decomposition | Not built in. |  |
| J-lens | A planned Reproduction Gallery entry; not built yet. |  |
| Dimension reduction | [Build a representational dissimilarity matrix](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/semantic_io.md) | `rdm = tl.repgeom.rdm(features)` |
| Model-difference amplification | Not built in; compare-runs shows site-by-site differences between two runs. |  |
| Post-training debugging | Not built in. |  |
| Architecture diagrams | [Draw the computational graph](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md); [Open an interactive viewer of a trace](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/reference/export.md); [Print a summary of the model](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/reference/summary.md) | `tl.draw(model, x)`; `tl.export.html(tl.trace(model, x), "trace.html")`; `print(tl.summary(model, x))` |
| Feature explorers | Not built in. |  |
| Guardrail monitor | [Monitor activations on a production inference server](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/non_goals.md); Outside TorchLens: it is not a serving-time monitor. |  |
| Interactive data viewer | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Dataset inspection | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Data attribution | Training-data attribution is outside TorchLens; input attribution is the attribution card. |  |
| Synthetic data generation | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Training pipeline | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Interpretability in training | Not built in. |  |
| Serving | [Monitor activations on a production inference server](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/non_goals.md); Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Evaluations | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Biological foundation models | Not built in; capture works on any PyTorch model. |  |
| Bioinformatics | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Biological database selection | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Biological model comparison | Not built in; neuro-compare compares a model with neural recordings. |  |
| Causal behaviors for biological models | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Research design | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Access verification | [Diagnose a capture problem](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/agent-reference/common-patterns.md) | `print(tl.report.doctor(model=model, inputs=x).to_markdown())` |
| Paper replication | See the Reproduction Gallery (docs/gallery). |  |
| Interactive HTML | [Open an interactive viewer of a trace](https://github.com/johnmarktaylor91/torchlens/blob/main/docs/reference/export.md); A trace viewer, not a research-thread report. | `tl.export.html(tl.trace(model, x), "trace.html")` |
| LaTeX | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Results publication | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Figures | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Job orchestration | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| GPU job checklist | Outside TorchLens. |  |
| Environment builds | Outside TorchLens. |  |
